spec.title: Astronaut presents chess set aboard ISS
spec.summary: An astronaut aboard the International Space Station holds a magnetic chess board with pieces arranged, talks to camera, gestures with both hands, moves a chess piece by hand, and lets it float away.
warnings: No objects are actually manipulated or moved during the clip; poses and sizes are estimated from video without scale reference and may be inaccurate.
